_about: What patches/apply.py does to a voice_mode package, in order. Paths are relative to the voice_mode directory; scripts and modules are relative to patches/. See docs/patching/README.md.

steps.why: never cut active speech at listen_duration_max
stop the turns[] playback thread on cancel (upstream PR #555)
no silent OpenAI voice swap; configurable STT timeout
import scipy.signal at start, not mid-recording: a cold import outlasts the 5 s stall backstop (voicemode#545)
a distinguishable session name in the conch
push-to-talk hold_start/hold_end commands
push-to-talk hold in the recording loop
a hold also cuts TTS
German voices get German text only
live playback state and barge_in; uses the hold patches' text when present
wake an idle Claude Code session: push-to-talk hold and the pill's Play
the voice server starts the pill window itself
the Windows pill window, for pill_autostart
the macOS pill window, for pill_autostart
modules go in before the pill patch makes converse import them
pill state, session registration, Pause and Stop; needs voice barge first
push-to-talk cuts TTS generation, records at once, a stop clears the hold; needs hold, barge and pill
named-pipe control channel where AF_UNIX is missing; needs control_transport.py
MCP tool for switching voice barge-in
per-harness wakers for the conch queue's callback mode
callback is served as wait where no waker can reach the session; wakers before upstream's tmux push
fair holds: a hold does not starve a waiting session
MCP progress heartbeat so a 180 s client timeout does not cancel converse
fair holds, progress heartbeat, a cancelled wait is logged; needs conch_hold.py and mcp_progress.py
only voice settings travel from voicemode.env into the environment; update_config refuses other keys
the transcript-saving git call is bounded (5 s, stdin closed): it froze the voice server for 176 s on Windows
a long reply is spoken in parts, one TTS request each (VOICEMODE_TTS_CHUNK_CHARS, default 300)
simple_tts_failover speaks a long reply in parts; needs tts_chunks.py
a timed-out local TTS request is not sent again buffered, so the server never generates the same speech twice
which language a local voice speaks, and ISO codes of language names
an uninstalled voice is spoken with an installed voice of its language
an uninstalled voice is spoken with an installed one of its language, never a 500, and converse says so; needs voice_fallback.py
the transcript echo lines' labels come from VOICEMODE_ECHO_ASSISTANT_LABEL and VOICEMODE_ECHO_USER_LABEL
the STT request passes the pill's language for the session; needs voice_pill_state.py and voice_languages.py
the voice_sensitivity tool's override of VAD aggressiveness and silence length (<base dir>/sensitivity.json)
each recording resolves VAD aggressiveness and silence length: converse argument, else the override, else config; needs voice_sensitivity.py

a mic stream that fails to start (Wait timed out, -9987) is re-initialised and retried once with silence detection; the fixed-length fallback ends on cancel and VOICEMODE_FALLBACK_RECORD_MAX_S caps it
audio-device calls off the event loop with a deadline; loop watchdog exits a stuck server (FELIX #2095)
RECORDING_END carries per-turn numbers and how the recording ended, no audio or text; the status reply carries listening_since for the pill (FELIX #2107); needs turn_stats.py
the pill's Done in one exchange: skip_forward only while a recording runs, decided under the control state's lock (Talos on FELIX #2104); needs voice pill and voice barge
optional: the two provider keys upstream reads may also come from voicemode.env; not in the Windows manifest or FELIX
